postings.title: People Team: Software Engineer Intern (Winter 2027)
postings.description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Location: Austin, Texas, US
Available Term: Winter (January - April 2027) 
About the Role
The team is building AI agents for the People team that can reason, act, and coordinate without constant human input. You will contribute to this foundation and gain firsthand experience. We value fundamentals, curiosity, and fast learning. Join the People Innovation Lab to rapidly build and deploy internal enterprise applications and tooling for the Cloudflare People & Places organization, focused on making work smarter.
What We Provide
Opportunity to solve real problems with AI and code.
Mentorship, dedicated manager, regular 1:1s, and structured support.
Real sprint work with production deliverables.
Access to Cloudflare's full intern cohort (community, events, network).
A portfolio artifact: production-deployed code and a shipped product demo.
What You'll Build & Do
You will build production features in a sprint-based team.
Work is guided by the IT Customer Zero team and deployed on Cloudflare infrastructure.
Strong fundamentals and fast ramp-up ability are essential.
Build and ship full-stack features, clean production code, and integrations for internal tools.
Write and review code, work in sprints (managing tickets/blockers), and coordinate with the other intern.
Effectively use AI-assisted coding tools.
Demo working products to leadership.
Requirements & Qualifications
Minimum Requirements
Pursuing CS, Software Engineering, or related degree (or equivalent experience).
Ability to build and demonstrate a working web application.
Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript and comfortable with one back-end language/framework.
Solid understanding of end-to-end web app functionality (HTTP, APIs, data persistence, deployment).
Experience with shared codebases such as Git and meaningful commits.
Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.
In office 3-5 days a week.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with serverless/edge computing.
Experience with a modern front-end framework (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.) and/or MCPs/APIs, data modeling, or systems design (for back-end seat).
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode).
Prior sprint-based team experience.
For UI seat: Experience with design systems, Figma, or strong interaction design sense.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

postings.title: Software Engineer Intern - Zurich (2027)
postings.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lake using open formats like Apache Iceberg, delivering deep correlation and long-term analytics at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Knowledge Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and guided workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause and resolution significantly faster.
The Infrastructure team at Observe by Snowflake is responsible for building, scaling, and operating the development and production environments that power our observability platform. We are a small, highly collaborative team with a broad scope, focused on delivering reliable infrastructure while continuously improving the systems that support our engineers and customers.
We’re looking for dedicated students who share our passion for ground-breaking technology and want to create a lasting future for you and Snowflake.
WHAT WE OFFER :
- Paid, full-time internships in the heart of the software industry
- Post-internship career opportunities (full-time and/or additional internships)

- A chance to work with world-class experts on challenging projects
- Opportunity to provide meaningful contributions to a real system used by customers

- Catered lunches, access to gaming consoles, recreational games, happy hours,
- company outings, and more
- Embraced as a full member of the diverse Snowflake engineering team
WHAT WE EXPECT :
- Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college/university program during the time of the internship
- Required: A completed BS degree, with an MS or PhD in progress
- Desired Majors: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Math, or related field
- Required coursework: algorithms, data structures, and operating systems
- Recommended coursework: Database systems, distributed systems, cloud computing, compilers
- Bonus experience: Research or publications in databases or distributed systems and contributions to open source.
- Experience working with big data (engineering / processing) and data migration
- Duration: 4–12 months (6 months recommended) start date flexible
- Target start dates: January 2027 and onward
- Excellent programming skills in C++ or Golang
- Knowledge of data structures and algorithms
- Strong problem solving and ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN/GAIN :
- How to build enterprise grade, reliable, and trustworthy software/services

- Understanding of database internals, large-scale data processing, observability space, distributed systems, warehouse scheduling
- Implementation, testing of features in metrics processing, warehouse scheduling, query execution

POSSIBLE TEAMS/WORK FOCUS AREA :
- Data management from ingestion to customer-defined batch-streaming

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
How do you want to make your impact?

postings.title: SLT Mechanical Design Intern
postings.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Join Intel's System Level Test (SLT) team within the Technology Development organization as a Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering Intern . The SLT team develops innovative test platforms and infrastructure that enable validation and high-volume manufacturing of Intel's leading-edge products.
In this role, you will collaborate with experienced engineers to design, analyze, and optimize mechanical and thermal solutions for complex test hardware and systems. You will contribute to the development of next-generation test platforms by supporting concept development, CAD design, thermal analysis, prototyping, laboratory validation, and system integration activities.
As a Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering Intern, you will gain hands-on experience solving real-world engineering challenges related to structural design, cooling technologies, reliability, manufacturability, and system performance. You will help characterize and resolve mechanical and thermal issues through experimentation, data analysis, and engineering simulations while working closely with cross-functional teams across mechanical, thermal, electrical, manufacturing, and system engineering disciplines.
This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to technologies that directly impact Intel's product development and manufacturing success while building technical expertise in mechanical design, thermal management, and semiconductor test systems.
Key Responsibilities
Designs and develops mechanical devices, systems, equipment, and packaging, creating practical mechanical designs that incorporate design for manufacture, design for serviceability, and design for sustainability considerations.
Develops system concepts from scratch, creates product and test specification based on requirements, drives system integration, development, procurement, acceptance, and deployment to high volume manufacturing.
Creates mechanical customer guidance for appropriate use of the designs and resolves customer concerns.
Defines and conducts feasibility studies and develops and implements test plans and parameters for new and existing mechanical designs, including functionality validation, reliability, and safety.
Lists the mechanical properties of the designed products or parts within a product and validates unique mechanical and/or thermomechanical solutions and equipment.
Applies deep materials knowledge and mechanical expertise to select right materials, components, and manufacturing technologies for the system.
Coordinates with suppliers to incorporate manufacturing feedback, produce the designs, and resolve manufacturing issues.
Conducts design reviews and performs system acceptance tests working with customers, drives structural and stress analysis of the key mechanical components such as the chassis structure, heat sinks, and thermal attachment, prototypes testing, initiates design improvement, and resolves design and implementation issues.
Performs Mechanical Simulation Engineering tasks, including creating mechanical finite-element model geometry and meshing with parametric scripting, developing material models from measured material characterization, executing and post-processing simulation static or transient solutions that accounts for system boundary conditions, manufacturing process steps, and reliability stress conditions.
Mechanical simulation structures can scale from silicon, packaging, PCBs, device system to multiple systems.
Executes tolerance analysis from component level to board and system level. Collaborates with thermal engineers, electromechanical engineers, industrial designers, and other system engineers to optimize the design parameters, deliver performance objectives, and partner with external vendors through initial conceptual studies, layout, design, fabrication, assembly, debugging, and validation.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your schoolwork, classes, research, relevant previous job, and/or internship experiences.
Minimum Qualifications
Must be perusing a master's degree in mechanical Engineer or relevant field with 1 year of hands-on experience in domain with demonstrated skills gained through internships academic projects coursework or hands-on training.
Experience listed above should be in any the following:
Proficiency in 3D modeling and AutoCAD.
Knowledge of design for manufacturing (DFM) principles.
Understanding of mechanical design fundamentals and hardware design.
Understanding of reliability and thermal principles in mechanical systems.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong problem-solving and group collaboration skills.
Effective communication skills for cross-functional teamwork.
Ability to innovate and adapt mechanical designs for diverse applications.
GPA: 3.0
We welcome individuals who are eager to contribute to impactful projects and grow their careers in mechanical design engineering. Join us to help shape Intel's mechanical solutions that drive innovation and create meaningful outcomes.

postings.title: Research Scientist Intern - Graphics, ML
postings.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Graphics Research Organization at Intel is seeking a highly motivated Research Scientist Intern to join its world-class team. This role offers an opportunity to help shape next-generation graphics technologies and experiences by conducting cutting-edge research in real-time 3D rendering, machine learning, and highly parallel algorithms.
As an intern, you will collaborate with industry-leading researchers to develop innovative graphics and AI techniques. Your work may contribute directly to Intel's graphics hardware and software products while advancing the state of the art in both industry and academia through research publications.
We are looking for curious, collaborative, and technically strong candidates who are passionate about graphics research, possess excellent communication skills, and are eager to explore new ideas that drive innovation.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on computer graphics and machine learning.
At least 1 year of academic, research, or industry experience in:
- Modern C/C++ and Python programming.
- Machine learning concepts, algorithms, and frameworks such as PyTorch.
- Advanced graphics techniques including rasterization, ray tracing, physically based rendering, light transport, sampling strategies, acceleration structures, level of detail, shading, appearance modeling, and Monte Carlo methods.
- Graphics APIs such as OpenGL, Vulkan, or DirectX, and/or shading languages including GLSL and HLSL.
- GPGPU programming technologies such as CUDA, SYCL, or OpenCL.
Preferred Qualifications
Publications in top-tier computer graphics, computer vision conferences, or journals.
Strong foundation in linear algebra, numerical optimization, probability, and statistical estimation.
Experience with image processing and computer vision techniques, including multi-scale filtering, Fourier transforms, optical flow, feature alignment, and image segmentation.
Familiarity with vision transformer models such as DINO, CLIP, and V-JEPA.
Experience developing neural rendering applications, including super-resolution, denoising, and deblurring.
Research or software engineering experience through internships, industry roles, open-source contributions, or competitive programming.
Experience applying machine learning techniques to real-time graphics problems.
Understanding of GPU architectures, graphics workloads, and performance optimization.
Experience with profiling, debugging, and performance analysis tools.
This internship is ideal for PhD students who want to push the boundaries of graphics and AI research while contributing to technologies that impact millions of users worldwide.

Business group
This position is part of Intel's Data Center Group (DCG), a dynamic organization dedicated to transforming how data is processed, stored, and analyzed across global industries. DCG drives innovation in server, cloud, and AI technologies, enabling Intel to deliver powerful, scalable solutions that support the future of computing. As part of this group, you will contribute to groundbreaking projects and make an impact on Intel's leading-edge technologies.

- Support the development of verification plans, test benches, and verification environments to ensure design architecture coverage.

- Assist with emulation and simulation tasks to validate designs, analyze power and performance metrics, and uncover bugs.

postings.title: Intern Software QA Test Engineer
postings.description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
IPL QA team is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of infrastructure and software solutions used across multiple product development teams. We work closely with development and infrastructure engineers to validate new features, detect regressions, improve test coverage, and continuously enhance automation frameworks.

postings.title: 2027 Intern - Research Scientist
postings.description:
Internship Details
Location: London
Duration: 3 months
Starting date: From February 2027
End date: No later than 30 November 2027
Eligibility: master or Ph.D. student
Hybrid: 3 days per week in the office, 2 days per week work from home
Annual Pay: £75,000
About the role
Research at the intersection of 3D, Image, Video, and Generative AI
Can we bridge the compact, physically consistent structure of 3D representations with the rich temporal priors of generative video models?
Join Adobe Research London to tackle core problems in multi-modal generation and controllable editing. We are looking for PhD and MS researchers to explore how unifying image, video, and 3D modalities can yield richer, more controllable generative spaces.
The Research Focus:
• Bridge 3D & Generative Video: Investigate compact 3D representations (e.g., neural fields, Gaussian splatting, explicit geometry) alongside video diffusion/autoregressive models to unlock precise spatial and temporal control.
• Combine Generative Models & Classical Rendering: Explore hybrid pipelines integrating physically based rendering (PBR) with generative/agentic workflows.
• Top-Tier Publication: Develop novel methods and target impactful publications at top-tier venues (SIGGRAPH, ACM TOG, CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICLR).
• Thesis Alignment: We actively prioritize research problems that can serve as core chapter(s) of your dissertation and establish sustained collaborations well beyond the internship.
Resources & Environment:
• Compute & Infrastructure: Large-scale GPU clusters and specialized datasets to train and evaluate state-of-the-art models.
• Mentorship & Impact: 1:1 mentorship from senior Adobe research scientists, with a direct pipeline to transfer groundbreaking ideas to creative tools used by millions worldwide.
Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing a PhD or MS in Computer Science, specializing in Computer Vision, Graphics, Machine Learning, or a closely related field. Exceptional senior undergrads with strong research output will be considered.
• Solid track record or coursework in generative modeling (diffusion / flow matching / autoregressive), computer graphics / vision, and/or 3D scene representation.
• Proficient in modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch) with strong experimental rigor.

60 minutes Technical Interview with the team.
45 minutes Soft-Skills Interview with the Hiring Manager.

Job Description:
Start Date: 1July 2027
Location: Winnersh, Reading
What you'll need
Placement eligibility: in the second year of a four-year degree that requires, or offers the option of, a one-year industrial placement in the third year.
On track for a 2:1 or above
Be eligible to work in the UK and available to start in July 2027 for a 13-month placement
Be self-motivated, resourceful and comfortable working independently while knowing when to seek guidance.
Demonstrate strong organisational and time management skills with a structured approach to work
Be adaptable to changing priorities and comfortable working to tight deadlines
Show creativity, curiosity and confidence in asking questions.
Possess excellent written, visual and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
Be collaborative and team-oriented
What you'll do
Support the HPC AI EMEA Go-to-Market team across communications, programs, business reporting and events
Create and maintain reports, dashboards and insights using Excel, Power BI and internal business systems to support decision-making.
Ensure accurate account alignment across systems in line with coverage models
Support Sales with pipeline management and Salesforce (SFDC) hygiene
Own and deliver key communications, including All Team Meetings and regular win announcements
Support key AI industry event and sponsorship activities
Work collaboratively with Sales, Strategy & Planning, Marketing, and Partner teams on a variety of new initiatives/projects ad hoc as needs arise
Contribute to charity initiatives, volunteering activities and cross-functional intern projects.
Provide administrative and operational support where required, including logistics and business coordination activities.
What you can expect from us
Develop expertise in business analytics, reporting, stakeholder engagement and commercial operations within a global technology business.
Gain hands-on experience using Microsoft Office, Salesforce (SFDC), and Power BI.
Build capability using industry-leading AI and productivity tools, including Copilot.
Learn about HPE’s HPC AI strategy, portfolio and market propositions.
Build relationships with the EMEA HPC AI Go to Market Leadership team and key stakeholders across the business.
Participate in HPE's intern programme, including Early Careers activities, Employee Resource Groups and office-wide initiatives.
Opportunity to complete sales readiness training delivered by industry experts.
Attend team meetings and business reviews.
Shadow team members during customer, partner and industry engagements.
Work alongside experienced professionals while developing your commercial acumen, analytical skills, proactive mindset and confidence using modern digital and AI-enabled business tools.

Job Description:
Locations: Winnersh, UK
Start Date: 1 July
At HPE, we advance the way people live and work by delivering intelligent, secure, AI-powered networking solutions that connect people, devices, and applications everywhere.
We are looking for an ambitious and high-potential Placement Year Student to join our Strategy & Planning organization in HPE Winnersh. This is an exciting entry-level opportunity designed for an individual at the beginning of their career who is eager to develop in their career with us.
You will receive ongoing mentoring, coaching, and practical experience across customer engagement, business development, networking technologies, AI-driven solutions, and partner ecosystems. The role combines sales development, customer engagement, account support, and community-building activities, providing an excellent foundation for a successful career in Strategy & Planning.
What you'll do:
Creating, providing and developing reporting packs for senior executives that track change within the business and assist in crucial decision-making processes.
Presenting and clearly communicating important strategic and financial information on a weekly basis using a variety of mediums.
Supporting members of the wider sales teams across UK and Ireland
Liaising with sales specialists and account managers to monitor business activities and offering support to them whenever necessary.
Using an analytical approach, provide valuable feedback, thoughts and opinions to the strategy, sales and finance teams.
What you'll need:
Currently in your second year of a three-year degree programme, or on a four-year degree that includes an industrial placement
On track to achieve a 2:1 or above
A degree background that demonstrates strong business, sales, finance or analytical capability is advantageous
Previous work experience, internships, part-time employment, leadership positions, volunteering, or meaningful extracurricular involvement that demonstrates initiative and drive
A strong work ethic, growth mindset, and genuine enthusiasm to learn, develop and build a career with Hewlett Packard Enterprise.
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and communicate effectively across a variety of audiences and channels
High levels of accuracy, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to identifying and driving improvements.
Confidence working both independently and collaboratively, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities and tight deadlines
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI, and a willingness to embrace them as part of your day-to-day work
